newsitem.title: USA: Quaker State to lift restriction on shares.
newsitem.headline: Quaker State to lift restriction on shares.

text.p: Quaker State Corp said on Friday that it filed a Form S-3 registration statement that would remove a restriction on 1.69 million shares that prevented them from being sold.

Stephen Blum, senior vice president of corporate relations, said removal of the restriction does not mean that all of the restricted shares that were issued as part of recent acquisitions will be sold.
Key employees and major shareholders at Slick 50 Inc and Blue Coral Inc received restricted shares when Quaker State bought the companies, Blum said.
